metadata.prompt:
Question: In Table 1 of the EIA Alaska Electricity Profile 2024, what net generation in megawatthours is listed for IPP & CHP?

A. 6,020,426 megawatthours
B. 670,080 megawatthours

Source citation: Alaska Electricity Profile 2024 (https://www.eia.gov/electricity/state/alaska/index.php)

Source text:
Alaska Electricity Profile 2024

Table 1. 2024 Summary statistics (Alaska)

| Item | Value | Rank |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Net summer capacity (megawatts) | 2,853 | 48 |
| Electric utilities | 2,639 | 39 |
| IPP & CHP | 215 | 50 |
| Net generation (megawatthours) | 6,690,506 | 48 |
| Electric utilities | 6,020,426 | 38 |
| IPP & CHP | 670,080 | 50 |

Data source: U.S. Energy Information Administration, Form EIA-860, Annual Electric Generator Report, U.S. Energy Information Administration, Form EIA-861, Annual Electric Power Industry Report, U.S. Energy Information Administration, Form EIA-923, Power Plant Operations Report and predecessor forms.

Supplied draft answer: A

output_text:
**Answer: B**

The source table clearly shows the breakdown under "Net generation (megawatthours)": Electric utilities is 6,020,426 and IPP & CHP is 670,080. The supplied draft answer (A) incorrectly cites the Electric utilities value rather than the IPP & CHP value.
